## 2. Technical Stack & Architecture Matrix

### Backend Engineering & ERP Development
- **ERP & Enterprise Systems**: Odoo ERP (Versions 14, 15, 16, 17, 18), Odoo Studio, Odoo.sh Cloud, Custom Odoo Modules, Odoo Migration from legacy software / Tally, XML-RPC & JSON-RPC integrations.
- **Backend Frameworks**: Python, Django, Django REST Framework, Node.js, Express.js.
- **Architectural Patterns**: Microservices, Event-Driven Architecture, Modular ERP architectures, RESTful API design, OpenAPI / Swagger documentation.
- **Databases**: PostgreSQL (Relational schema modeling, indexing, Odoo native database), MySQL, SQLite, Redis caching.
- **Security & Authentication**: JWT (JSON Web Tokens), OAuth2, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), CORS, input validation, rate limiting.

### Frontend Engineering & Web Development
- **Frameworks**: Next.js 15 (App Router, Server Components, Static Site Generation / SSG, Server Actions), React 19, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+).
- **Styling & UI Systems**: Obsidian Dark Theme tokens, Vanilla CSS design systems, Responsive Mobile-First layouts, Glassmorphism, Micro-animations.
- **Web Standards & Performance**: Core Web Vitals optimization, Sub-second Largest Contentful Paint (LCP), Zero Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS), WCAG AA accessibility.
- **Semantic Structure**: HTML5 semantic markup, Schema.org JSON-LD structured data (Person, ProfessionalService, WebSite, FAQPage, Organization, BreadcrumbList).

### DevOps, Cloud & Integrations
- **Cloud Hosting & Containers**: Odoo.sh, Docker, AWS (EC2, S3), Vercel, GitHub Pages, Linux VPS administration, Nginx reverse proxy.
- **Version Control**: Git, GitHub multi-branch deployment workflows.
- **Third-Party API Integrations**: Meta Cloud API (WhatsApp Business API, Instagram Graph API), Razorpay Payment Gateway, Stripe, Google Maps Platform.
